Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth

Class MtlsEndpointAliases

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth.MtlsEndpointAliases
public class MtlsEndpointAliases extends Object
Builds the mtls_endpoint_aliases metadata claim of RFC 8705 (section 5): the addresses of the endpoints that authenticate clients on the dedicated TLS port, the issuer's host with authserver.x509.port. Nothing is added while that port is not configured.
